review_comments: Can we use go's HTTP client?
if err.load != nil will we appendMPUPart？
keep the value same with s3?
How many retry times of the client?
Seems not retry internally, it only rely on upper layer retry
How can we ensure the writer is finally canceled?
there's no context of this function 🤔 I'm more worried about it's blocked
I'll leave it for some time, to check if we can allocate bytes from membuf.Pool and use `cleanup` to release the bytes.
for above and this comments: these codes are copied from https://github.com/liqiuqing/gcsmpu
What for? Is the time enough?
I guess it means GCS uploader can only use the signed URL to upload data parts before it's expired
